description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin called 'removeformat' that adds functionality to remove formatting from selected text, including removing specific tags and attributes, and provides related configuration and filter mechanisms.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.removeformat
classes.description: Object containing the removeformat command and filter functions for the CKEditor plugin.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.removeformat.commands.removeformat.exec
methods.description: Executes the remove format command, removing specified tags and attributes from the selected range.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.removeformat.filter
methods.description: Filters elements to determine if they should be considered for removal during the removeFormat command.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.prototype.addRemoveFormatFilter
methods.description: Adds a custom filter function to determine whether specific elements should be removed during formatting removal.
